Field Notes p. 04

Rye in the High Desert

At 7,200 feet, water boils differently, yeast breathes differently, and Marta Reyes has spent eleven years learning what the altitude wants.

The first thing Marta Reyes tells me is that everything I know about hydration is wrong — or at least, wrong here. Her bakery sits at the edge of Taos, where the air is thin enough that a standard 78% hydration dough behaves like batter by noon…
